Test Objective: Vet uploads valid JPG avatar and profile saves
Test Steps: 1. Login as Veterinarian. 2. Open My Profile > Edit Profile. 3. Choose a JPG file under 2MB via camera button. 4. Save Changes.
Expected Results: Profile redirects with success; Users.profile_picture_url is /uploads/avatars/vet-{userId}-{timestamp}.jpg; avatar shows on profile with new image.
Preconditions: Active vet account; file <= 2MB | Type: Positive

Test Objective: Upload PNG / GIF / WebP for any role using edit-profile
Test Steps: 1. Login (Customer or Admin or Lab or Receptionist). 2. Edit Profile. 3. Select PNG (or GIF/WebP) under 2MB. 4. Save.
Expected Results: File stored; DB path updated; image visible on profile and header (if applicable).
Preconditions: Role has edit-profile page | Type: Positive

Test Objective: Reject upload when file exceeds max size
Test Steps: 1. Edit Profile. 2. Select image > 2MB. 3. Save.

Preconditions: Multipart limit 2MB file / 6MB request | Type: Negative
